# infrawrench_sso_directory_groups (Data Source)

Every group in the organization's SCIM directories, as Directory Sync reports them. The way to find a group's id for `infrawrench_sso_group_role_mapping` by its name, for example with a `for` expression over `groups`. Requires single sign-on to be set up.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Directory groups, across every connected directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The organization id. A plural data source has no identity of its own; this is the conventional placeholder.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `directory_id` (String) The directory the group belongs to.
- `directory_name` (String) That directory's name.
- `id` (String) The group id, `directory_group_…`.
- `name` (String) The group's name in the identity provider.
